title: #IUIC #Bishop #Nathanyel7 #IsraelUnitedInChrist
segments: She was so slick. She sent me the
grocery list of what she needed because
she was going to tell her man she was
going to the store. So, she had about a
good 40 minutes of being at the store.
So, she gave me the grocery list so I
can get what's needed at the store. She
came back, came to my crib instead of
the store. And she got the 40 minutes.
